name: auto_traces
description: Scenario traces from the real functions: a party member wearing Auto-* / SOS gear, random hits (HP and the weak-level byte), sweeps, KOs, revives, casts and lapses; the counters, the Regen clock, HP and the weak level after each operation.
notes: slot indices are the thirteen temporal counters: 0 Sleep, 1 Silence, 2 Darkness, 3 Shell, 4 Protect, 5 Reflect, 6 Nul-Tide, 7 Nul-Blaze, 8 Nul-Shock, 9 Nul-Frost, 10 Regen, 11 Haste, 12 Slow.

a trace starts with the battle first apply at the starting HP; cast only sets a counter that was 0; lapse only ends a finite one; the character is slot 3 of a field of otherwise empty slots; maximum HP is 1000.
